# cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_domain_acl (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_domain_acl" "example_zero_trust_cws_domain_acl" {
  account_id = "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
  domain_acl_id = "182bd5e5-6e1a-4fe4-a799-aa6d9a6ab26e"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) Cloudflare account ID (32-character hexadecimal string)

### Optional

- `domain_acl_id` (String) ID of the domain ACL to retrieve
- `filter` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `default_action` (String) Action applied when no entry matches the request domain
Available values: "ALLOW", "BLOCK".
- `entries` (Attributes Set) Per-domain action overrides. Each domain appears at most once. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))
- `id` (String) ID of the domain ACL to retrieve
- `name` (String) Human-readable name; unique per account
- `updated_at` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Optional:

- `deployment_id` (String) Filter to domain ACLs attached to this deployment
- `direction` (String) Sort direction (default: asc)
Available values: "asc", "desc".
- `name` (String) Filter by domain ACL name (case-insensitive substring match)
- `order` (String) Field to order results by (default: created_at)
Available values: "name", "created_at", "updated_at".


<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) Per-domain decision overriding the parent ACL's default_action
Available values: "ALLOW", "BLOCK".
- `domain` (String) Hostname or domain pattern, capped at 255 UTF-8 bytes
